reviews.review: Really enjoyable game overall for what it is

fun looter shooter with enough things to spend time with farming, good rewards for events, awesome outfits (even tho, imo, the solo person skins are as expensive as universal skins, and the rest is overpriced as heck...) still, i greatly enjoyed it and the base skins are pretty well made so its fine i guess ^^

After playing for a few hours, the game is "okay" for a free to play. The prices for all of their microtransactions are extremely overpriced so, keep it "free to play" unless you enjoy throwing money away (like me sometimes). A lot of  the attire in this game is aimed towards a more "thirsty" audience as you can see.

I ended up buying ONE normal looking armor/attire set for a character named "Ultimate Viessa" thinking it was for my current character also named "Viessa" but in reality my Viessa couldn't USE it because it was for the Ultimate version of her? I don't know, it was confusing. Customer Service denied me the currency (called Caliber) back even though I explained to them I was new and didn't know.  I understand that all sales are "final" in this game but the way this is set up is dumb and confusing for new players. 

I only don't recommend this because the people running this game don't care about keeping paying customers or their fans happy, they only care about your wallet. I understand this is true for most developers nowadays but there are better games to spend your time and money on. If you play this, try to keep it free. Your mistakes won't be refunded.

It was a great game before they ♥♥♥♥♥♥ everything up in the last patches. Unless you play the meta Descendant or weapon, you need way too long to kill a boss in one of the newer missions. One need to run those missions over and over again, which is fine, but why can't I just nuke the boss to do so? 

Simply annoying....
Fun silly little shooter looter. I really like the "plot"
